mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, address, phone, sort, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_campus WHERE id = #{campusId} AND status != 2 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code, name, address, phone, sort, status, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_campus WHERE status != 2 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_campus WHERE name = #{name} AND status != 2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_campus WHERE code = #{code} AND status != 2
